item.title: The ‘war Cabinet’ film and the unsettling reality around us
item.description: It’s not enough to gloat that Malta is one of the safest countries in the world. It only takes a single act of madness to change that statistic to the worse. And while that is not something we would like to entertain; it cannot be ignored or minimised

item.title: The Mediterranean is shifting and Malta cannot afford to stand still
item.description: The stark truth is far less comforting. Neutrality does not eliminate risk. It does not prevent conflict spill-over. It does not deter technological threats. It simply defines our military alignment

item.title: Russia’s shadow fleet sails past Malta all the time. Here’s why that’s a concern
item.description: To conceal the origin of cargo, vessels may also engage in ship-to-ship transfers, disable their tracking systems, transmit falsified location data, or otherwise obscure their movements

item.title: WATCH | Jonathan Abel: ‘We’re successful because we mirror what happens in life’
item.description: Jonathan Abel is a veteran radio presenter with a career spanning different stations. He speaks to Karl Azzopardi on his passion for the medium, his co-hosts’ departure from Vibe FM, and the untimely death of his father

item.title: War, fragility and frugality: The case for a resilient Malta
item.description: Energy prices, shipping routes, tourism flows and financial markets are all transmission channels through which geopolitical shocks quickly reach our shores
